newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Placer to acquire rest of Highlands.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Placer to acquire rest of Highlands.

text.p: Canadian mining group Placer Dome Inc said on Thursday it will move to compulsory acquisition of the outstanding shares in Highlands Gold Ltd after its takeover offer closes on Saturday.

Placer said its holding in the Papua New Guinea (PNG) miner had risen to more than 91.6 percent and it had received legally binding undertakings to accept its A$0.75 a share offer which will take to overall holding to more than 93 percent.

"Placer currently intends to close its offer on Saturday 15 February and immediately thereafter initiate compulsory acquisition of Highlands and delisting from the Australian Stock Exchange," it said.

Highlands in late January recommended its shareholders accept the offer after Placer agreed to a restructuring proposal whereby Highlands would float off a separate company, Highlands Pacific Ltd, which would hold the company's assets in PNG and Indonesia, excluding its 25 percent stake in the huge Porgera gold mine in the PNG highlands.
